answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the oasis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
